notes.title: Whispering Abyss Full Release
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IVCOROe.jpg[/img]

[b]WELCOME TO DULUTH.[/b]

[i]It's been a long time coming, but Grace is finally coming back to her hometown, Duluth, to unearth the mysteries of her mother's disappearance over 10 years ago. Carrying only her revolvers and her sun necklace gifted to her by her dear mother, she is determined to brave the deep of the Abyss.

Will you discover the truth of the ever-changing Abyssal Trench? Will Grace find closure to her mother's disappearance? 

Dive into the deep; it's calling for you.[/i]


[b]WELCOME TO PRECIPICE GAME'S FIRST OFFICIAL STEAM GAME RELEASE![/b]
After nearly 10 months in production, the devs are proud to present Whispering Abyss. This action-packed, top-down rogue-like will be available for purchase tomorrow, Friday, October 28th, at 3:00 PM EDT for $2.99.


[b]KEY FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lore-enriched gameplay is shown through unlockable journal pages, secret lore bits, and much more.
[*] Exotic items that drastically change the way the game is played.
[*] Randomly generated levels that make each run new and exciting!
[*] Beautiful environments and distinct enemies with special attack patterns!
[*] Enemies, items, and special NPCs inspired by Lovecraftian lore!
[/list]

[b]Like what you hear? [/b]Be sure to wishlist and purchase the game to play for yourself after launch!
[b]Can't wait?[/b] Be sure to sign up to get notified of its official release!
